channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: DDEC reported $2.62 billion in committed private investment across 30 relocation/expansion projects and over 16,200 jobs, while American Airlines confirmed its largest-ever winter operation in Puerto Rico and Crowley and NSF-backed Arecibo C3 advanced smaller workforce and STEM investments. Federal dollars also continued landing in smaller increments, including USDA rural grants and a $3.7 million release to UPR tied to fiscal-reporting progress. On the risk side, a San Juan Bay standoff between New Fortress Energy and harbor pilots tripled power-generation costs, an investigative report raised serious water-supply doubts about the proposed Esencia luxury resort in Cabo Rojo, and Puerto Rico still shows recessionary signals alongside $8 billion in uncommitted Hurricane Maria reconstruction funds nine years after the storm.
